displayName: OCI-WSTG09-001: SSRF to Internal Services and Cloud Metadata
description:
Detects SSRF requests targeting internal services, localhost, and cloud metadata endpoints

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: ssrf to internal services and cloud metadata

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg09_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%ssrf%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%internal%') AND "value" > 0
